accepted.sentence: In its native range, wild populations occur in open, seasonally dry habitats rather than beneath dense forest canopy.
In some tropical homesteads, dense rows are planted as living barriers, their sharply edged leaves discouraging passage.
Fresh puree is sometimes used in meat marinades, where its enzymes tenderize protein during a brief soak.
Without flowering treatments, plants may bloom at uneven times, spreading fruit maturity and complicating a coordinated harvest.
In warm, rain-soaked fields, heart rot can damage the plant’s growing point and threaten the developing crop.
Commercial cultivation is concentrated in lowland tropical belts, since cool highland conditions can slow growth and delay fruiting.
When kept whole at moderate room temperature, harvested fruit can remain usable for several days without immediate refrigeration.
At roadside markets in growing regions, vendors may sell freshly cut portions as ready-to-eat snacks for passersby.
